_comment: PRODUCTION ENVIRONMENT - This configuration is for Azure deployments only.
_security: Connection strings MUST be configured via Azure App Service Configuration > Connection Strings, NOT in this file.
_instructions: In Azure App Service, navigate to Configuration > Connection Strings and add 'DefaultConnection' with your Azure SQL connection string. The value here serves as a fallback only.
_databaseNote: Production MUST use Azure SQL Database (SqlServer). SQLite is not allowed in production and will cause startup failure.

ConnectionStrings._instruction: Set via Azure App Service Configuration > Connection Strings. Example: Server=tcp:yourserver.database.windows.net,1433;Initial Catalog=yourdb;User ID=youradmin;Password=yourpassword;Encrypt=True;TrustServerCertificate=False;Connection Timeout=30;
